tasks.name: LearnConceptUsingVersionSpaces
tasks.description: Learn a target concept by iteratively applying candidate elimination to an arbitrary sequence of labeled examples until convergence.

tasks.name: InitializeVersionSpace
tasks.description: Set the initial specific and general boundaries from the first training example.

tasks.name: ProcessExample
tasks.description: Update the version space for the next labeled example by generalizing the specific boundary for a positive example or specializing the general boundary for a negative example.

tasks.name: CheckConvergence
tasks.description: Determine whether the specific and general boundaries have converged on a stable concept description.

tasks.name: FailureGoal
tasks.description: Represents unsuccessful execution of concept learning.

tasks.name: Complete
tasks.description: Represents successful completion of concept learning.
